Tourism in Russia Arab travelers: Russia has become more attractive to Arab travelers, as it combines modernity and tradition, simple rural life and the hustle and bustle of major cities, and is full of natural and historical areas for lovers of exploration and adventure. This article contains all the information and advice that an Arab traveler needs before traveling, in addition to answering the most important questions about tourism in Russia. Follow along with me.  Russia is a transcontinental country. Russia extends in northern Asia and eastern Europe. It is the largest country in the world in terms of area, and contains many different terrains, including mountains, volcanoes, and forests, in addition to many rivers and lakes. Russian is the official language in Russia, and it is not considered a barrier to your travel, and workers in hotels, shopping centers, and restaurants speak English. Surprisingly, Russia has more than 100 other languages! This is due to the multiplicity of ethnicities, which reach 190 different ethnicities, such as the Tatars, the Caucasus, and others, and this was the reason for the enormous diversity of cultures in Russia. The official currency is the Russian ruble, and one dollar is equivalent to 84 Russian rubles. As for means of transportation, Russia has an integrated transportation network for moving inside and outside cities, such as the metro, buses, trains, taxis, and planes. Russian cuisine is characterized by many traditional dishes, thanks to the diversity of cultures within Russia, and this means that there are many distinctive experiences awaiting the Arab tourist. You can try dishes such as borscht and beef stroganoff, which dates back to the nineteenth century; There are restaurants serving halal food, which is an important point for the Arab traveler. Russians tend to greet each other in a formal manner, and prefer to maintain an appropriate distance from others. They usually don't start talking first, but they are friendly and pay attention to appearance and dress. They also appreciate gifts when they are invited home, and show their respect and gratitude by eating all of the food offered. Islam ranks second among the most widespread religions in Russia, and this is good news for Arab travelers, which means complete safety and comfort and the availability of places of worship and mosques in many places. As well as the ease of obtaining halal food in many restaurants, there is a great opportunity to engage in the culture. There are many options available in the range of luxury and budget hotels, such as the Metropole Hotel and the Boco Hotel, as well as other options such as youth hostels and furnished apartments that provide comfortable and safe options for Arab travelers. There are eleven time zones in Russia, which is a very, very large number. This means a huge diversity in climate and temperatures, and therefore a different atmosphere for each city. The best season to visit Russia is the summer, when the temperatures are moderate and suitable for carrying out tourist activities, unless you are a fan of winter climates and activities. Travel to Russia A comprehensive tourism experience that combines stunning nature, ancient historical cities, and distinctive Soviet architecture. Russia is characterized by wonderful cultural and historical diversity, and among the most famous historical places that you can visit are Red Square and the Kremlin in Moscow The capital, which is considered a symbol of ancient Russian history, contains many historical monuments. Don't miss visiting the palaces, such as the Hermitage and Catherine Palace and the Peterhof Palace in the city St. PetersburgThe palaces, with their decoration and architecture, demonstrate an authentic part of Russian culture and historical heritage. The palaces have their own parks for walking and playing, as well as independent gardens and parks such as Moscow Park. You can visit the ancient cathedrals in which the city of Kazan is famous, as well as the Qul Sharif Mosque, which is considered the largest mosque in Russia and is distinguished by its wonderful architectural design. You can visit theaters such as the Bolshoi Theater, attend artistic performances, and attend folk festivals. There are mountain ranges in Russia, such as the Caucasus and the Ural Mountains, which open the way for adventure lovers to practice mountain activities such as climbing, cycling, and snowboarding. There are many rivers that intersect between the mountains, where you can do hiking.Trips River boating, and forest camping.
Russia includes five other natural regions that are on the UNESCO World Heritage List, such as the golden Altai Mountains, Lake Baikal, which is called the jewel of Russia, and the Kamchatka volcanoes. It is one of the questions that concerns Arab travelers in the current situation, and the answer is that Russia is a safe country, and you will always notice the presence of police patrols everywhere you visit. However, it is best to avoid wandering alone in remote areas at night, not to carry valuables in plain sight, and to pay attention while crossing roads, as there are some who do not abide by traffic rules. In order to be able to travel and enter Russia, you must obtain visa Login or Visa to RussiaYou can do this by filling out a visa application form electronically through the Russian Federal Foreign Affairs website. 
Then print it, sign it, and deliver it to the Russian embassy inside your country with some papers, which are a valid passport, a personal photo, your national ID card, a bank statement, confirmation of a hotel reservation for accommodation, and also round-trip airline tickets.
